💳 Payments and penalties:
Our system provides safe and convenient payment options.

💰 Payment methods:
- Card payment
- Cash payment

⚠️ No-show:
- 1 time: warning
- 2+ times: penalty or mandatory card payment

📌 Goal: fair usage of stadiums
cancel: ⏰ Booking cancellation rules ✅ You can cancel a booking at least 5 hours before it starts. Cancellation is not possible when less than 5 hours remain. 💳 For paid bookings: If more than 5 hours remain before the start, the amount you paid is refunded in full (100%). Nothing is withheld. 🔁 Cancelling an unpaid booking involves no payment, so nothing is refunded or withheld. 🕒 Once your refund request is received, the funds are returned to your original payment method within a few business days. 📌 These rules are the same for all users and also protect the interests of stadium owners.
